summary: ExoZymes Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a proposed public offering of common stock and warrants. The offering consists of units of two shares of common stock and one warrant to purchase one share, exercisable at 125% of the offering price per share starting one year after issuance. The warrant exercise price may be reset under certain conditions. MDB Capital, the underwriter, is a related party and conflict of interest exists; Lucid Capital Markets serves as qualified independent underwriter. This is a routine capital raise with no special-situation event such as acquisition, activist campaign, or strategic review.
